page.overview:
Who is Cartney Carsper?

Cartney Carsper is a minor character in Cars 2.

In the film, Cartney Carsper is a race fan seen in the crowd at the second World Grand Prix race in Porto Corsa, near Pope Pinion IV. She is a huge fan of Lightning McQueen.
